description: Raw attendance alerts (アラート) Kintai Plus already raised for you: 打刻忘れ, 欠勤疑い, 遅刻, 早退, 残業時間閾値超え, 36協定, 工数未入力, 休憩不足, and others. The API cannot filter; month (YYYY-MM, Japan time) is applied here. Omit month for every month the API returns. close_out already folds the relevant alerts into a prioritized list — call get_alerts only when you need the raw rows.

month.description: Only alerts for this month (YYYY-MM, month 01-12, Japan time). Omit for all months returned by the API.

name: get_alerts
title: Get my attendance alerts
